description: Plain-language engineering question over the whole platform, answered by platform rules without any external model: selection by requirements, values of a property across a class, companies by capability and country, launch windows, term definitions. Returns a short answer plus data blocks (candidates A/B/C, values, companies, launches). Use when the question does not map cleanly onto one structured tool.

q.description: the question in English or Russian, e.g. "star tracker better than 10 arcsec under 1 kg", "who makes batteries in Germany", "what is TRL"

name: ask_console
